verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Turso Platform API reference exists ('Programmatically manage databases, groups, organizations, and tokens with the Turso Platform API'). Nothing shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, such as a try-it console or playground. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no machine-readable spec to back an interactive explorer. A static API reference is only adjacent to this story and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
